title: datura stramonium f. inermis
intro: Datura stramonium f. inermis, commonly known as the pricklyburr or thornless jimsonweed, is a variant of the Datura stramonium plant that lacks the thorns found on the typical species. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of anxiety, insomnia, and pain relief. The therapeutic actions of Datura stramonium f. inermis are attributed to its sedative, antispasmodic, and analgesic properties, which are a result of its bioactive constituents, including scopolamine and hyoscyamine. The bioactive constituents of this plant have also been reported to have anticholinergic and anti-inflammatory effects, which contribute to its therapeutic actions.
